description: Get currently selected photos in Lightroom (or filmstrip if no selection). Paginated.

include_path.description: Include each photo file path (default false). Rows always include photo_id, filename, rating (0 = unrated), flag, color_label and date_time_original, and stack (position, is_collapsed, top_photo_id) for a stacked photo.

name: get_selected_photos
title: Get selected photos
